intro.body_1: It still happens in your inbox, on your phone and in your head.
intro.body_2: Temas works from the hours, the threads and the listings you already keep. A reply stays a draft until you send it, and a viewing is booked only when someone picks a time you have offered.

viewings.meta_title: Viewings the tenant and the applicant can both do
viewings.meta_description: Temas finds the hours you and the current tenant are both free and shares them as one booking link. The viewing is booked when an applicant picks a time and confirms.
viewings.title: A viewing at a time you, the current tenant, and the applicant can all do.
viewings.lead: Finding that hour is still a chain of messages. The tenant is home, the applicant can only come after work, and the gap before the next viewing gets forgotten.
viewings.problem_body: You text the current tenant, then the applicant, and sometimes the owner. One of them replies tomorrow. The hour you offered is already gone.
viewings.how_title: From the tenant's evenings to a booked viewing, in seven steps.
viewings.outcome_1: A time the tenant, the applicant, and you can all do.
viewings.outcome_2: No messages back and forth to find it.
viewings.outcome_3: Everyone told, with a reminder before.

s1.title: Send the current tenant a link.
s1.body: Open the viewing calendar on Riverside flat and invite Daniel, the current tenant. He gets a magic link by email or WhatsApp. No password, and he sees only this property.

s2.title: The tenant adds the hours they are home.
s2.body: On his own page, Daniel picks days and times in three short steps: Tuesday and Thursday, 17:00 to 20:00. If his week changes, he edits it and the times follow.

s3.title: You add yours once.
s3.body: Your hours repeat every week: weekdays, 10:00 to 19:00. You also set how long a viewing takes and the gap you need before the next one.

s4.title: Temas keeps only the overlap.
s4.body: Where your hours and Daniel's meet, Temas fits 30-minute viewings with a 15-minute gap after each. Tuesday and Thursday get 17:00, 17:45, and 18:30. When the owner has to be there, their hours become a third set.

s5.title: Share one booking link with applicants.
s5.body: Send the link by email or WhatsApp. Applicants see a month of open days, and on each day only the times that already work for you and the tenant.

s6.title: The applicant picks a time and confirms.
s6.body: Olivia picks Tuesday at 17:45, adds her name and email, and types the six-digit code we email her. Nothing is booked until she does.

s7.title: Booked, and everyone knows.
s7.body: The viewing lands on the workspace calendar. Olivia, Daniel, the assigned agent, and the workspace owners get a confirmation, then a reminder two hours before. Either side can reschedule or cancel.

inbox.title: One reply, from the thread and the listing, still yours to send.
inbox.lead: Gmail and WhatsApp do not know which property the question is about. The same question gets answered twice, and a reply can go out before you have checked the listing.
inbox.problem_body: The applicant writes on WhatsApp. The owner writes by email. You are the only person who holds both, and the answer has to match that flat.
inbox.how_title: From a WhatsApp question to a reply on the right listing.
inbox.outcome_1: Email and WhatsApp in one list.
inbox.outcome_2: A reply drafted from the thread and the listing.

s1.title: Connect your own Gmail and WhatsApp.
s1.body: In Settings, connect your Google account once for mail and calendar, then pair WhatsApp by scanning a code. The connection belongs to you, not to the office.

s2.title: Every message lands in one list, on the right listing.
s2.body: Emails and WhatsApp messages sit together. Temas matches each one to the person and the property by their phone or email, so the listing is already on the row.

s3.title: Open the thread and see both sides.
s3.body: Their messages and your replies, including ones you sent from Gmail, sit in one conversation. Olivia wants blackout curtains and asks to see the flat this week.

s4.title: Draft with AI, in your tone.
s4.body: One click writes a reply from the last messages, the listing, and your signature. Pick formal, friendly, or short. The draft stays a draft until you edit it or send it.

s5.title: A viewing request brings the booking link.
s5.body: When the message asks to see the flat, the draft adds the listing's booking link, so Olivia can pick a time you and the tenant already have free.

s6.title: You send it, from your own account.
s6.body: The reply goes out from your WhatsApp and stays on Riverside flat. Only you see this mailbox. Not a colleague, and not the agency owner.

pricing.faq_title: What you pay for, and when.

q1.question: Is the plan per person or per office?
q1.answer: Per workspace. The same login can sit on a Team workspace at the office and a Solo workspace of its own, each on its own plan.

q2.question: Do I pay when I sign up?
q2.answer: No. Signing up does not charge you. You choose a plan and pay later, from Settings > Billing.

q3.question: How does Team pricing work?
q3.answer: Team is priced per agent, for up to 50 agents. You pay for the seats that are in use.

q4.question: What counts as an AI message?
q4.answer: A question in AI Chat uses 1. A reply draft uses 3, an applicant summary 2, and a contract draft 8. Chat titles, task suggestions, and reminders use none.

q5.question: What changes on the yearly plan?
q5.answer: The monthly price is lower and you pay once a year. Solo gets more listings and AI messages. Team gets unlimited listings and more AI messages.

q6.question: What happens if I cancel?
q6.answer: The workspace goes back to the Solo monthly plan.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Temas is a letting workspace for real estate agents. ProducterHQ OÜ, an Estonian private limited company, operates it. This policy says what personal data the product stores and who can see it.

sections.title: Who decides
paragraphs: When an agency uses Temas, that workspace decides why listing, people, message and file data is kept. ProducterHQ OÜ processes that data only to provide the product.
ProducterHQ OÜ decides for itself about accounts, security logs and, once a payment starts, billing records.

sections.title: What is stored
paragraphs: An account is an email address and a profile, signed in with a magic link. A workspace holds its name, official company name, members, roles and plan.
A listing can hold the property facts, the owner, the current tenant, applicants, files, inventory, tasks and contract drafts.

Gmail and WhatsApp that an agent connects are stored for that agent only. A colleague and the agency owner do not see those threads. The same Google connection can show that agent's own calendars beside the workspace viewings. Those events stay private to them.
Ask questions, drafts and the short summaries used to search a workspace are stored with that workspace. A contract draft is stored on the listing until the agency deletes it.

sections.title: Why
paragraphs: The data is used to run the workspace: find a viewing time, keep applicants moving, draft a reply or a contract, and remind the people the agent chose to notify.

A reply stays a draft until the agent sends it. A viewing is booked only when someone picks a time the agent has offered. Ask answers from records the signed-in person is allowed to see, and it does not book, cancel or send on its own.

sections.title: People who are not agents
paragraphs: An owner or a current tenant opens a magic link and sees only the property they were invited to. A prospective tenant has no account. A booking or form link shows that page, and email confirmation is used where the page asks for it.
Those links are not a view of the rest of the agency.

sections.title: Where it is kept
paragraphs: The workspace database and files are hosted in the EU (eu-central). The application is hosted on Vercel.

Connecting Google or WhatsApp, sending email, or using Ask, a draft or a contract sends the data that feature needs to that provider. Those providers can process it outside the EU. The providers are Google (Gmail and Calendar), Meta (WhatsApp), Resend (email), Anthropic and OpenAI (AI), Inngest (background jobs), Supabase (database, sign-in and files) and, when a payment is taken, Stripe.

sections.title: How long
paragraphs: Workspace data stays while the workspace is open. Closing an account or asking us to delete a workspace removes that data, except records we have to keep for the law or an unpaid invoice.
Disconnecting Gmail or WhatsApp stops new mail and messages from arriving. Copies already stored for that inbox are removed when the account or the connection is deleted.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to see, correct, delete, limit or receive a copy of personal data ProducterHQ OÜ holds about you, and you can object to a use that is based on a legitimate interest.

If the data was entered by an agency, ask that agency first. They decide about their listings and their clients. You can also complain to the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon), or to the authority where you live.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Temas uses cookies to keep you signed in, to remember the open workspace, and to remember the calendar view you last chose. It does not use advertising cookies.

terms.meta_description: The terms for using Temas, operated by ProducterHQ OÜ.
terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms are between you and ProducterHQ OÜ, an Estonian private limited company, for the use of Temas. If you use Temas for an agency, you confirm that you can accept them for that agency.

sections.title: The service
paragraphs: Temas is a letting workspace. It keeps listings, finds viewing times from the hours you and the current tenant have given, drafts replies, tracks applicants and tasks, and drafts contracts from facts already on the listing.
A feature can change or be withdrawn. Signing a document inside Temas, collecting rent, and publishing to listing portals are not part of the service.

sections.title: Accounts
paragraphs: You sign in with a magic link to your email. One login can belong to more than one workspace. Each workspace has its own role and plan.
The workspace owner manages members, the official company name and billing. An agent works the portfolio and their own inbox. They do not change billing or member roles.

sections.title: Your content
paragraphs: You keep the listings, files and messages you put in Temas. You give ProducterHQ OÜ permission to host and process them so the product can run.
You are responsible for having a lawful reason to store an owner's, a tenant's or an applicant's personal data, and for what you send them.

sections.title: Connected mail and WhatsApp
paragraphs: Connecting Google lets Temas read and send from that mailbox, and read and update that agent's calendars, only as the product describes. Connecting WhatsApp does the same for that number.
Those threads stay visible only to the person who connected them. You can disconnect either one in Settings.

sections.title: AI and contract drafts
paragraphs: Ask, inbox drafts and task suggestions are drafts for you to check. Temas does not send a message, book a viewing or cancel one unless a person does.

A contract draft is a starting point filled from the listing. It is not legal advice and it is not a finished tenancy agreement. You review it, and a lawyer should review it, before anyone signs. Country rules on deposits, notice and registration are yours to add.

sections.title: Plans and payment
paragraphs: Prices are in US dollars and are the ones shown on the Plans section and in billing. Solo is one price for one agent. Team is a price per agent. Yearly is paid once a year at the lower monthly rate.

Creating an account does not take a payment. A charge starts only when you complete checkout. Until payment is switched on, choosing a plan only saves that choice. Each workspace is billed on its own.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use Temas to break the law, to send mail or WhatsApp the recipient did not agree to receive, to upload something you have no right to store, or to try to read another person's inbox.

sections.title: Stopping
paragraphs: You can stop using Temas at any time. ProducterHQ OÜ can suspend a workspace that breaks these terms, or that does not pay after checkout has started.

Except where the law does not allow it, liability for the service in a year is limited to the fees that workspace paid for Temas in the previous twelve months. ProducterHQ OÜ is not liable for a decision you make from a draft, or for a contract you export.

sections.title: Law
paragraphs: These terms use the law of Estonia. The courts of Estonia hear disputes, without taking away a right that a mandatory law in your country gives a business or a person.
